name: @repo/text-morph
description: A TextMorph text animation component for SmoothUI.

useCases: Swapping labels, counters or status text without a jarring cut
Live-updating headlines where only part of the string changes
Word or character diff transitions between two strings
compositionHints: Pass a new `text` value to trigger the morph — the component owns no state
Use `mode="words"` for longer phrases, `mode="characters"` for short labels
